raw_text: A contested encounter in South Kashmir's Shopian district has triggered widespread protests despite an internet shutdown imposed by authorities. Scroll.in has confirmed that protest calls spread rapidly on Telegram and X before the shutdown, using coded language for rally points. After the shutdown, VPN-tunneled posts continued with coordinated timed message bursts, highlighting the limitations of internet blackouts as a crowd control measure.
clean_text: Shopian encounter triggered protests despite internet shutdown. Protest calls used coded language on Telegram and X. VPN-tunneled posts continued after shutdown with coordinated timed message bursts.
